activity_summary: You rehearsed the comedy with the door shut and no bill up. Heminges counted seven days to Easter Monday. Garnish refused another paste. Sam sang the cuckoo clear. Kemp wanted a laugh and did not get one. Arthur's two hooks were still split, and Edith was not sent for. You did not let a hem down, and you did not open any other play.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept one book, refused a hem, and left the morning on Navarre.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Counted seven days, no bill, and no seamstress.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Asked for a laugh and a hat, and got neither.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Set Sam on the breath, and stopped him when clear was enough.

entities.name: Sam Latchet
entities.context: Sang the cuckoo clear, and stood quiet when told.

entities.name: Arthur Meeks
entities.context: Named two split hooks and agreed to turn slower.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Refused another version and kept the plot where it hung.

entities.name: Edith Kettlewood
entities.context: Mentioned. She was not sent for, and she did not let a hem down.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: Easter Monday is seven days from this morning, and seven is a date.

quotes.speaker: augustine_phillips
quotes.text: Sing it on the breath, not on the word.

quotes.speaker: abel_garnish
quotes.text: The slip is on. One book.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not calling for a hem.
